subject: Legend for raw data plot in Deducer

messages.author: 296e86a536d6e730
messages.subject: Legend for raw data plot in Deducer
parts:
Hello all,

Another newbie question. I want to do a simple plot of raw data from this frame:

   DataCount InsertComp SelectComp
1        200      10042       7631
2        400      40083      31062
3        800     156971     127728
4       1600     610171     447628
5       2400    1301776     986332
6       3200    2399768    1699826
7       4000    3911613    3033709
8       4800    5724429    4193321
9       5600    7593564    5795173
10      6400    9886413    7314809

I add geom-point and geom-line for DataCount (x) and InsertComp (y), then do the same for DataCount (x) and SelectComp (y). I can shape and color the points and lines. I read in a tutorial that "By default, R will group by discrete aesthetics like color." It seemed to indicate that a legend would be produced automatically based on the group by color. However, I get no legend.

How do I create a legend in Deducer for my raw data?

Thanks,
Stan

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Legend for raw data plot in Deducer
parts:
Your data is in wide format, whereas it needs to be in long format to make the legend. This can be done in code with:

#make fake data
dat <- data.frame(matrix(rnorm(300),ncol=3))
colnames(dat) <- c("DataCount","InsertComp","SelectComp")

#change to long format
library(reshape2)
dat1 <- melt(dat,id="DataCount")

Then, in the plot builder, add "DataCount" and "value" to the x and y aesthetics, and then toggle the color option so that you can enter "variable" as a color aesthetic.


ian

parts:

ian
